business_summary: Celestra Inc., a biotechnology company, provides genome-based cancer and disease diagnostic solutions. It provides TrioDx RT-PCR COVID-19 Test (FDA EUA), liquid biopsy and precision medicines, health care services, and big data solutions. The company's liquid biopsy and precision medicines include CD-PRIME, a platform that offers automated protocols for tumor cells (CTCs), cell free DNA, and EV (exosome) derived from cancer tissues; Cancer-PRIME, a cancer gene analysis service for analyzing results to precision medicine information with bioinformatics and the detection of various gene mutations; and BioViewCCBS, a scanning platform that helps in capturing cells inside the sample in 3D and in finding and analyzing CTC inside the sample. It also acts as the distributor and seller for AmoyDx's diagnosis method kit in Korea, which is a diagnostics kit used to predict NSCLC patients; for Fluxion Biosciences' Spotlight 59 Panel that provides sensitive detection result with a design for mutated cell detection in cancer samples; and for Fluxion Biosciences' IsoFlux System, an analysis system for circulating tumor cells to extract rare cells. In addition, the company provides health care services, such as Geno-P, which provides specialized genome information for 11 physical characteristics based on genome standard reference data; Geno-D that provides prediction services for probability of incidence of diseases; GenomeBook, which provides whole genome information; NIP10, an examination service that is possible after 10 weeks of pregnancy through non-invasive, pre-birth examination to detect fetal chromosome abnormalities; and biological age analysis service. Further, it provides BioComputer, which is an automated computing infrastructure solution to process genomic data. Celestra Inc. was formerly known as Clinomics Inc. and changed its name to Celestra Inc. in March 2025. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Ulsan, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 생명공학 회사인 Celestra Inc.는 게놈 기반의 암 및 질병 진단 솔루션을 제공합니다. TrioDx RT-PCR 코로나19 테스트(FDA EUA), 액체 생검 및 정밀 의약품, 헬스케어 서비스, 빅데이터 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사의 액체 생검 및 정밀 의약품에는 종양 세포(CTC), 무세포 DNA 및 암 조직에서 추출한 EV(엑소좀)에 대한 자동화된 프로토콜을 제공하는 플랫폼인 CD-PRIME이 포함됩니다. 결과를 생물정보학으로 정밀의학 정보로 분석하고 다양한 유전자 변이 검출을 위한 암 유전자 분석 서비스인 Cancer-PRIME 그리고 샘플 내부의 세포를 3D로 캡처하고 샘플 내부의 CTC를 찾아 분석하는 데 도움이 되는 스캐닝 플랫폼인 BioViewCCBS가 있습니다. 또한 비소세포폐암(NSCLC) 환자를 예측하는 데 사용되는 진단 키트인 AmoyDx 진단법 키트의 국내 유통 및 판매 역할을 맡고 있습니다. 암 샘플에서 돌연변이 세포 검출을 위한 설계로 민감한 검출 결과를 제공하는 Fluxion Biosciences의 Spotlight 59 패널용; Fluxion Biosciences의 IsoFlux System은 순환 종양 세포를 분석하여 희귀 세포를 추출하는 시스템입니다. 또한 회사는 건강 관리 서비스를 제공합니다.
